Contract:
Render after the current artifact is written and verified:
1. One concise line names the produced artifact paths and exact checks that passed. 2. `**Что дальше?**` with 2–4 concrete options derived from current repository artifacts. While a scope in the dependency graph lacks an approved spec, recommend the next spec. Offer scaffold only when all intended specs have approval #1. Scaffold means creation and validation of actual tickets, not implementation. 3. A selected chained option loads its owner directly with exact artifact paths. No hidden session context is transferred; the next owner reconstructs state from specs, tickets, Execution Log, Git, and tool output. 4. «Пауза — продолжу позже» prints one short resume instruction containing the next skill and scope/Task-ID. Pause is always safe because durable artifacts are complete enough to resume. 5. When no chained work remains, report completion. There is no terminal state token and no session close command.
